title: Promise NP-hardness
statement: A pair of Boolean-string languages $(Y,N)$ is promise NP-hard if $Y$ and $N$ are disjoint and, for every language $L$ in NP, there is a polynomial-time promise reduction from $(L,L^c)$ to $(Y,N)$, where $L^c$ is the complement of $L$.
hypotheses_covered: For every language $L$ in NP, there is a polynomial-time promise reduction from $(L,L^c)$ to $(Y,N)$
